rootCause: 各层日志存在但没有同一完成事件与可出港边界：backend 只覆盖局部 security、frontend 只在内存/开发 console、ErrorBoundary 未接消费者、bootstrap 使用自由 stdout；补齐后又暴露公开邀请 token 与前后端 correlation/requestId 未对齐的跨层 join 缺口。
generalizedFailureMode: 有调用却没有 owner/route/face/status/outcome 的可关联 completion 证据，或把敏感 payload/自由输出当作可观测性。
redMutations: retain public invitation token in route event
minimalRepair: typed foundation completion event + one generated-route edge observer + optional redacted frontend sink + both app boundary callbacks + structured bootstrap logger
excludedCounterexamples: public security operations retain their existing dedicated observer
managed diagnostic/seed requests are excluded from the new observer to avoid harness double counting
no runtime endpoint or remote sink is claimed by static proof
prevention: six-class source denominator in S2 manifest
